hyperedges.label: Van Sales Daily Cycle
hyperedges.description: The five core entities that form the complete Van Sales daily operational cycle: create loading sheet, operate in van mode, invoice each customer, collect payment, and close the day with stock reconciliation

hyperedges.label: Purchasing Inbound Flow
hyperedges.description: The three sequential steps of the inbound stock purchasing flow: create PO, receive goods (GRN), and pay the supplier

hyperedges.label: Automatic Journal Entry Triggers
hyperedges.description: Receipts, supplier payments, and GRNs all automatically post journal entries to the finance module — forming the auto-journaling pattern described at the end of the document
